lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahi jaahi anek mar mar janamate ||
lines.translation: Many come and go; they die, and die again, and are reincarnated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭੁ ਵਾਦਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਤੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bin boojhe sabh vaad jonee bharamate ||5||
lines.translation: Without understanding, they are totally useless, and they wander in reincarnation. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinh kau bhae daiaal tinh saadhoo sa(n)g bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: They alone join the Saadh Sangat, unto whom the Lord becomes Merciful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਜਨੀ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naam tinhee janee jap laiaa ||6||
lines.translation: They chant and meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਨੰਤ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojahi kot asa(n)kh bahut ana(n)t ke ||
lines.translation: Uncounted millions, so many they are endless, search for Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਨੇੜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jis bujhaae aap neRaa tis he ||7||
lines.translation: But only that one, who understands his own self, sees God near at hand. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: visar naahee daataar aapanaa naam dehu ||
lines.translation: Never forget me, O Great Giver - please bless me with Your Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਉ ਏਹੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavaa din raat naanak chaau ehu ||8||2||5||16||
lines.translation: To sing Your Glorious Praises day and night - O Nanak, this is my heart-felt desire. ||8||2||5||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਕੁਚਜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 1 kuchajee ||
lines.translation: Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Kuchajee ~ The Ungraceful Bride:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਞੁ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਅੰਮਾਵਣਿ ਡੋਸੜੇ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)nj kuchajee a(n)maavan dosaRe hau kiu sahu raavan jaau jeeu ||
lines.translation: I am ungraceful and ill-mannered, full of endless faults. How can I go to enjoy my Husband Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕਿ ਚੜੰਦੀਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik doo ik chaRa(n)deeaa kaun jaanai meraa naau jeeu ||
lines.translation: Each of His soul-brides is better than the rest - who even knows my name?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਅੰਬੀ ਛਾਵੜੀਏਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhee sakhee sahu raaviaa se a(n)bee chhaavaReeehi jeeu ||
lines.translation: Those brides who enjoy their Husband Lord are very blessed, resting in the shade of the mango tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੰਞੁ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਜੀ ਦੋਸ ਧਰੇਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: se gun ma(n)nj na aavanee hau kai jee dos dhareu jeeu ||
lines.translation: I do not have their virtue - who can I blame for this?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਥਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਘਿਨਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa gun tere vitharaa hau kiaa kiaa ghinaa teraa naau jeeu ||
lines.translation: Which of Your Virtues, O Lord, should I speak of? Which of Your Names should I chant?

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਟੋਲਿ ਨ ਅੰਬੜਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikat tol na a(n)baRaa hau sad kurabaanai terai jaau jeeu ||
lines.translation: I cannot even reach one of Your Virtues. I am forever a sacrifice to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਕੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: suinaa rupaa ra(n)gulaa motee tai maanik jeeu ||
lines.translation: Gold, silver, pearls and rubies are pleasing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਸਹਿ ਦਿਤੀਆ ਮੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: se vasatoo sahi diteeaa mai tinh siu laaiaa chit jeeu ||
lines.translation: My Husband Lord has blessed me with these things, and I have focused my thoughts on them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਰ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੰਦੜੇ ਪਥਰ ਕੀਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)dar mitee sa(n)daRe pathar keete raas jeeu ||
lines.translation: Palaces of brick and mud are built and decorated with stones;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਏਨੀ ਟੋਲੀ ਭੁਲੀਅਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਬੈਠੀ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau enee tolee bhuleeas tis ka(n)t na baithee paas jeeu ||
lines.translation: I have been fooled by these decorations, and I do not sit near my Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਰਿ ਕੂੰਜਾ ਕੁਰਲੀਆ ਬਗ ਬਹਿਠੇ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)bar koo(n)jaa kuraleeaa bag bahithe aai jeeu ||
lines.translation: The cranes shriek overhead in the sky, and the herons have come to rest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਚਲੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa dhan chalee saahurai kiaa muhu desee agai jaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: The bride has gone to her father-in-law's house; in the world hereafter, what face will she show?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਤੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਝਾਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਭੁਲੀ ਵਾਟੜੀਆਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sutee sutee jhaal theeaa bhulee vaataReeaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: She kept sleeping as the day dawned; she forgot all about her journey.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਹੁ ਮੁਤੀਅਸੁ ਦੁਖਾ ਕੂੰ ਧਰੀਆਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tai sah naalahu muteeas dukhaa koo(n) dhareeaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: She separated herself from her Husband Lord, and now she suffers in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਗੁਣ ਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣਾ ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh gun mai sabh avaganaa ik naanak kee aradaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: Virtue is in You, O Lord; I am totally without virtue. This is Nanak's only prayer:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੈ ਡੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh raatee sohaaganee mai dohaagan kaaee raat jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: You give all Your nights to the virtuous soul-brides. I know I am unworthy, but isn't there a night for me as well? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਸੁਚਜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 suchajee ||
lines.translation: Soohee, First Mehl, Suchajee ~ The Noble And Graceful Bride:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa too taa mai sabh ko too saahib meree raas jeeu ||
lines.translation: When I have You, then I have everything. O my Lord and Master, You are my wealth and capital.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh a(n)tar hau sukh vasaa too(n) a(n)tar saabaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: Within You, I abide in peace; within You, I am congratulated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਭਾਣੈ ਭੀਖ ਉਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaanai takhat vadaaeeaa bhaanai bheekh udaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: By the Pleasure of Your Will, You bestow thrones and greatness. And by the Pleasure of Your Will, You make us beggars and wanderers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਥਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਵਹੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਫੁਲੈ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaanai thal sir sar vahai kamal phulai aakaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: By the Pleasure of Your Will, the ocean flows in the desert, and the lotus blossoms in the sky.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਝਿ ਭਰੀਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaanai bhavajal la(n)gheeai bhaanai ma(n)jh bhareeaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: By the Pleasure of Your Will, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean; by the Pleasure of Your Will, he sinks down into it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਰਤਾ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaanai so sahu ra(n)gulaa siphat rataa gunataas jeeu ||
lines.translation: By the Pleasure of His Will, that Lord becomes my Husband, and I am imbued with the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਸਹੁ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਾ ਹਉ ਆਵਣਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਮੁਈਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaanai sahu bheehaavalaa hau aavan jaan mueeaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: By the Pleasure of Your Will, O my Husband Lord, I am afraid of You, and I come and go, and die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਤੋਲਵਾ ਹਉ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਈਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too sahu agam atolavaa hau kahi kahi dhahi paeeaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: You, O my Husband Lord, are inaccessible and immeasurable; talking and speaking of You, I have fallen at Your Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਮੈ ਦਰਸਨ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa maagau kiaa kahi sunee mai darasan bhookh piaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: What should I beg for? What should I say and hear? I am hungry and thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee sahu paaiaa sach naanak kee aradaas jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I have found my Husband Lord. This is Nanak's true prayer. ||2||
